A '''clone trooper''' served under [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he was part of the team sent to rescue [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]], who was being held captive in the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]] on the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]]-held world of [[Lola Sayu]].<ref name="The Citadel" />

==Personality and traits==
As a clone of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] this clone stood at 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|Imperial standard meters]].<ref name="The Citadel" />

==Equipment==
This trooper utilized white [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]], a standard [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]], and a [[Backpack/Legends|Backpack]].<ref name="The Citadel" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the episode, the clone was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who voices all clone troopers through the series.
